headline: Trace+ reads your whole project and tells you what the edit has stopped needing.
notes: All media: every clip in the project, used and unused, filtered by kind
What the unused footage weighs, measured off the files rather than estimated
Anything imported more than once, and every empty bin, off the same project walk
Move unused media into a bin in one click, mirroring your bin structure or flat
Put back: anything you filed away and later cut back in returns to the bin it came from, and the empty bins go with it
Put back can happen automatically as you edit. It is a setting, and it ships turned off
Click a clip on your timeline and the panel follows it, including inside a multicam
Unused parts: the minutes of a clip you imported and never touched, not just the clips you never touched at all
Compare cuts: what is in this sequence that is not in that one
Markers on every use, in the colour you choose, and one menu item to take them all off again
Export a CSV of whatever is on screen, filters and all
Colour chips, filter pills and a text size slider, so a project with 200 clips in it stays readable at any dock width
